about_the_game:
Step back into the charming world of Discounty with the official soundtrack – a heartfelt collection of original tracks that capture the warmth, personality and everyday rhythms of your favourite discount store.

Featuring a mix of over 50 retro melodies, the Discounty soundtrack brings to life the game’s vibrant atmosphere from early morning shelf-stocking to moments of discovery with customers and residents in the game.

James Evans is the talented composer behind Discounty’s charming soundtrack and has crafted an atmospheric soundscape that transports you to the town of Blomkest.

Whether you’re reliving your favourite scenes or just looking for a comforting backdrop to your day, this soundtrack is your perfect companion for work and play.
